## **Permissions**

### For permission to use graphics from the NECSI papers and website, please send a request to [office@necsi.edu](mailto:office@necsi.edu) and indicate the type of use e.g. book, article, blog, etc.

### Use will generally be granted for academic or non-profit purposes if citation is made to the original paper.

### Commercial use will also generally be granted, but we may request more detailed information.

### If formatting allows, a link should be included to the NECSI webpage on which the paper is posted.
